reviews.text: Got seen very quick and was told by the vet what to do next time with my cat very helpful.
Great team. Friendly, approachable and supportive. They managed to fit us in urgently and help as best as they could. Thank you
Hi, Lisa. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

Wimbledon Vets was recommended by our usual vets for a heart scan for our senior Pom’s heart murmur. The clinic was very friendly and welcoming from start to finish. It was a breeze to sign up for an appointment, file the intake form, and make an adjustment. The customer service was top notch, we immediately felt welcomed. The vet was kind and patient. Everything was explained by Dr Blackburn perfectly and simply!
Dental work completed on my french dog. Staff very attentive and caring
I have bought my 2 doggies to this practice, they have been treated with love and care. I can highly recommend this vet. I am very grateful for the service and the price.
Wonderful care, highly recommended this vet clinic
As allways very good sirvice

My elderly cat has asthma and recurrent chest infections. She has repeat longterm antibiotic injections, which really improve her quality of life. Vets, nurses and admin staff are all friendly and helpful and my cat is not afraid when we visit!

This is the second time I have been here for my dog's heart scan. The front desk staff were very friendly. Niamh, the vet, was also friendly and explained the whole process to me as well as the findings of the test afterwards. She was also very good with my dog.
Ran to time, lovely vet who explained clearly, medication dispensed quickly, clear safety netting
Outstanding. Alway feel welcomed and listened to. I feel that my pet is in good hands.

I cannot praise Wimbledon Veterinary Surgery highly enough.  They have always taken great care of my slightly (!) troublesome, but nonetheless loveable cat Ziggy.   They even brought him back from the brink earlier this year when he suffered some complications with diabetes.  They really care about the animals in their charge, and they are always so friendly, welcoming and caring towards me, too.  Many thanks and 5 stars!!!

Thank you for your review. We have checked our records but are unable to recognise your name as a client of our practice. We would like the opportunity to look into this further. Would you please contact the practice directly and speak with a member of our team on 020 8540 7275.

We will be happy to discuss your concerns and investigate what may have happened.
Hi, Jim. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

This is a great practice. All the staff are friendly and super helpful.
Nice and easy to get an appointment. I’d highly recommend.
Saw a lovely vet called Delphi. So thorough, kind , patient and explained everything well
Hi, Maria. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

The practice has a great atmosphere and ambience. The reception staff warm, kind, knowledgeable and extremely helpful.
The vets are knowledgeable, gentle and have a great deal of empathy with the animal they are working on.
Staffs are so friendly. Easy to book appointments.

Jordan on reception managed to get me an appointment for my Labrador very quickly even though he wasn’t initially registered with the practice.
We saw Viraf and have also seen Adam who made a huge fuss over my dog to make him feel comfortable and really gave him a good health check. I would highly recommend Wimbledon Vets to anyone, it didn’t feel rushed at all and was a great service.
The vets care about our cats! Reception staffs are kind and helpful as well.

Wimbledon veterinary practice go above and beyond, the reception staff are so helpful and friendly and the vets are so good with our very nervous cockapoo. Nelly needs to have a bimonthly injection and about an hour ago Niamh gave her the injection in a way that the dog didn’t even notice! Amazing caring service

Aston had hurt his eye and looked quite serious, we’re not from the area but they managed to get us in and seen and back to our accommodation with appropriate medication with in a couple of hours at a reasonable price, massive thank you to Mikey for looking after our boy, highly recommend these guys for looking after your ‘baby’s’
Hi, Claire. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

My dog was booked in for a heart scan,they phoned the evening before to tell me their machine had broken down and it would be a week before repair. They then suggested I travel from Chessington to Croydon or to Streatham Hill for an alternative scanner.  Can you imagine how stressful either of those journeys would be to a elderly dog with a heart condition would be? So I found a veterinary centre very near me, 10 mins down the road. Thankfully my dog will have a more relaxed scan done now!!
Very proffessional, eased the anxiety.
Excellent
Hi, Jacob. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
Hi, Bernard. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

Edited -
After weeks of chasing to make sure there were no outstanding charges after my cat was put to sleep, and not hearing back, they sent me a surprise bill over 3 months later without any explanation. The vets themselves are brilliant and I always felt like my cat was very well looked after. I would not  group again though as I no longer trust them due to their serious lack of communication and hidden charges.

Went today for the first visit for my kitten who's 2 months old for vaccine, microchip and dewarming. It was all done very well within 5 minutes of seeing the vet.  It cost me £121. I had my 2 children with me and were allowed to witness the treatment.  Thank you all.

Fantastic vet practice! We've always been seen promptly and have received excellent care for our cats. Viraf is exceptional—kind, knowledgeable, and genuinely invested in the wellbeing of every animal he sees. Dani, the area manager, is equally fantastic on the admin side of things. Her dedication and follow-through make a huge difference.
Great vet practice.  Easy enough to get an appointment. Friendly staff.

Fantastic vets. Have taken care of my cat for over 12 years and, despite spending most of my time away from London these days, I've never considered changing vets. They really care and I've never felt over-charged or pushed into unnecessary tests or treatments. Thank you Wimbledon Vets!

A huge thank you to the wonderful team at Wimbledon Veterinary Surgery for the care that our Twiggy received from a puppy and the support we felt as first time dog owners.

Viraf and team have always been so gentle and patient with Twiggy, always helpful in answering our questions or concerns, and Kerry at reception is so welcoming & friendly!

Twiggy has been on the VIP plan since she was a puppy and due to moving house we are now sadly leaving, but would highly recommend this Veterinary Surgery.
Hi, Sven. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

They have been our Veterinary Surgery for close to 20 years for our 2 cats. Very efficient, professional, with a friendly approach that makes the vet visits more relaxing, even when in an emergency or crisis.
I also appreciate that we are given treatment options when available, and that they are not unnecessarily pushing for the most expensive course of action.
I would highly recommend them.

Excellent vets. Up to date with current knowledge and treatments. Take time to listen to concerns. Niamh in particular is excellent.
Reasonably  priced too.
Hi, Jhin. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Affordable, friendly reassurance and great customer service.
Lovely practice and easy to get to in Wimbledon. The receptionist and the vet who saw us are so lovely too. Good vibes and my cat is vey calm there.

Very glad to have such a kind gentle experience with Adam when worried about my male cats bout of diarrhoea that's lasted 2 weeks with weight loss and off food,  but drinking normally. Adam  was courteous  and pragmatic due to my financial restraints suggested a conservative approach that would still not cause my cat futher distress. I appreciated this as I was  embarrassed because I was unable to afford a  investigative  scan and bloodwork.  My cat is doing well on the advice given and  gradually increasing his  appetite  and resuming normal behaviour. Thank you. I highly recommend this caring vet.
very professional
Wonderful staff
Great veterinary surgery, professional and really considerate and transparent with pricing information
Visiting a vet can be stressful and expensive yet the warmth from reception or the calm vets can turn a crappy day into a slightly better one.
Very caring staff, great communication throughout the process and gave my pet the necessary care it needed after it's injury

Looked after my cat really well and went the extra mile, she came out groomed/washed as well as the procedure she had. They seem to really care there and explain things well.
All the vets and veterinary nurses here are very professional and kind. I have always had excellent service, been able to get appointments easily and promptly. Would happily recommend.
Very helpful kind the best vets
All good.
Amazing service and amazing staff!!! Absolutely love Nina and Amiga's new vet!!!❤️❤️❤️
Lovely vet practice and Adam is very helpful.

Warning about the Little VIP Puppy Plan and prices.

We booked an appointment under the pre-paid plan, which the website says covers 'all the advice, support, veterinary care and treatment your puppy will need during their first year'; there are no exclusions. We sought advice about the timing of spaying within the first year.

However, when we left the appointment, the receptionist charged us £50, stating that we were not allowed to discuss spaying advice.

When we asked for clarification, the vet clinic kept demanding money.

This charge does not align with the promotional material or the terms and conditions of the VIP plan, and we were not told of any charge prior.

Be wary of the VIP plans and their costings.

They made myself and my puppy feel so welcomed! The vet took his time to explain everything to me and went over things a couple of times if I needed him to. Nothing seemed too much, was so happy thank you!
Hi, Joanna. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

Excellent and considerate service for my lovely very old cat. I was very nervous taking him in for his blood tests but Andy, the vet, and the veterinary assistants were extremely kind and gentle with him. We'll be back in 3 months for his next check to keep his bonny and healthy in his old age. Definitely recommend.
Hi, Adam. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!

Exceptional from walking in the door to the after care service provided weeks later. The staff are superb. Each of them are warm, knowledgable and professional. Urgent surgery requested in the late afternoon - undertaken without any drama within 2 hours! Couldn’t recommend them enough.

I've recently moved to this surgery for my four rescues. I am so glad I chose Wimbledon Veterinary Surgery - they really have been outstanding with all of the recent issues my cats have been through. Constant communications and warm and understanding staff from the wonderful receptionist o the awesome vets (particularly Viraf and Josh) who have made me feel at ease when my babies have needed treatment or check ups, they simply couldn't be in better hands. Really good value for money and they put the care of your baby at the top of their concerns.

We honestly can’t recommend Wimbledon Vets enough. Our dog is usually very anxious, but he loves coming here (we practically have to drag him past the door if we’re not actually going in!). The reception staff are always lovely and welcoming, and the vets are incredibly kind, patient, and give really clear, helpful advice.

Our dog recently had a major procedure and we were worried it might put him off, but it’s been the complete opposite — he seems to love visiting even more now. Such a fantastic team all round.
Exceptional and really went extra mile to make Luna feel welcome and the consultant was great and helped to give the necessary to help our miniature 15 week old Dachshund out. Thank you!

Our experience with this surgery has been good so far. We took our little kitten for a check up and then a neutering appointment, the staff are friendly and looked after him well. My only issue was that we were not advised to forgo feeding the kitten the morning of the neutering, so we had to leave him at the clinic for a few hours before he could have the procedure done. This should have been communicated to us when booking the appointment.
Had a lovely first visit with my pup! He enjoys being fussed over so I’m sure he won’t mind his next visit!!
They always make us feel less worried and take good care of our cats.
All the staff are amazing! They are kind and helpful the pets and their owners, making you feel very welcome in the surgery.

We are Mignon’s family, and we sincerely thank Dr. Viraf, the doctor we trust the most in the UK.

Mignon has been coming to this clinic since he was a baby, and Dr. Viraf has always cared for him with incredible attention and dedication. Recently, Mignon became very ill and had to be admitted to the hospital. Dr. Viraf spent over 30 minutes patiently answering all our questions, guiding us through every step, and comforting our family during a frightening time. Thanks to his care, Mignon has fully recovered.

Dr. Viraf is not only highly skilled but also truly compassionate. We are sad that we won’t be able to visit as often due to our move, but if we return to Wimbledon, we will definitely come back.

We are deeply grateful and highly recommend Dr. Viraf.
Hi, Pavlinka. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
Greats vets, easy to get appointments, friendly and professional staff

I was seen by Dr Irani for my cat who is poorly. Dr Irani was so warm friendly and informative. He was so patient with my two children who also attended the appointment with me and were asking 100 questions! But Dr Irani seem unphased and was so kind. Faye at Reception was so lovely and warm too. Great experience.
Hi, Alex. We must have done something right to get such a good rating from you. We really appreciate you taking the time!
Exceptionally helpful and friendly vets and staff. I always feel totally confident in their diagnosis and treatment.
Hi, Andrew. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

Unfortunately, my recent experience has been far from positive. I’ve been a loyal customer for over seven years and never encountered any issues before, but the lack of customer service over the past several weeks has been shocking.
I purchased medication for my dog, and as usual, the practice assured me they would handle the insurance claim. A week passed with no submission, so I called and was told there were delays due to staffing issues, but that it would be sorted soon. Since then, I’ve sent five emails, made three calls, and waited five weeks—yet nothing has happened. The most frustrating part is that no one is taking responsibility.
I’ve submitted the claim to my insurance myself, but part of the process still requires action from the practice based on information they received from the insurer. They are simply sitting on it. At this point, I’m seriously considering moving to another practice. If such a trivial matter is met with this level of indifference, I can’t help but wonder what would happen if my pet needed urgent care.

Cannot recommend enough. Brilliant experience getting our kittens spayed at the surgery. The staff have been 10/10 throughout the whole process - really friendly and reassuring. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vets in Wimbledon! We're new in the area and we're so glad we picked this surgery! Shout to Adam and Niamh and the rest of the staff 🙏
Great service.

We are new clients at the practice and couldn’t be happier to have registered here! My puppy went in for bloods and an ultrasound, and still came out relaxed and happy - I couldn’t ask for more than that! I’m grateful to know we have a wonderful practice to go to whenever my dogs need care in the future

A really impressive experience getting our puppy vaccinated. We were treated superbly throughout and our puppy came away with everything he needed, and I received some very useful advice and reassurance.

I have been taking my dog to Wimbledon Vets since he was a pup and they have always made him feel so welcome and looked after him with such love and affection as if he was the vets own dog. We are very lucky to have Wimbledon Vets. Thank you so much for all your help and support over the years.
Hi, Y. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5

Absolutely blown away by the efficiency,care and support from the vets ,Raife and Adam.
My dog had to have emergency surgery to remove a very large quantity of bladder stones. As you can imagine the distress we felt for our little pooch. She is fine now thanks to the care of such a wonderful surgery. Thank you.
Excellent customer service, we signed up to the VIP pet plan, and it’s very nice to know that my animals feel as though they are in safe hands.

I’d highly recommend this vet! I came in thinking I had booked an appointment on the day and had instead booked it in 3 days time, but they still saw me. Staff were so friendly and knowledgable too!

Just want to thank Kerry the receptionist for being such a ray of light. Always greeted warmly, very caring and professional, and puts us owners and our pets at ease. It makes such a difference to have someone like her front of house. You are a star, thank you so much!
Great staff who really care
I brought my cat in for a dental scale and polish yesterday, the vet was amazing, and reception staff very kind, I knew she was in the best hands possible, thank you so much.

An hour before, they called to say that based on the symptoms I listed for my cat—and the fact they close at 4pm—they wouldn't have enough time to help and suggested I go to a 24-hour hospital much farther away. Emergency appointment, and always see you.

Great vets! Always polite, friendly and helpful. Have been a client for many years and wouldn’t go anywhere else.
Remy had a great first visit!
Excellent service. Vet explained everything fully & reception girl  & care assistant were welcoming & helpful.

Wasn’t happy with these vets. They charged us £60 for 2 tiny eye drops tubes. When I commented on the price it was documented on our dog’s record by the male receptionist, saying that I didn’t want to pay. When I saw this it was quickly amended by office manager. but I’ve kept original. Total greed! as they know we will pay for our sick animals because we love them.

Absolutely best vet in town! Reception and doctor Viraj is ever so kind to assist will all the questions we may have!!!! Dukes mum :)

I’ve been to the practice a couple of times now with my kitten for her check ups and vaccinations and the veterinary nurses and vets have been lovely. It’s a friendly atmosphere and well located, very glad I joined.

This vet was recommended to me, I cannot recommend their services highly enough, all staff are extremely caring, very professional and very accommodating in seeing our poorly cat who required an operation, they saw us on the same day and carried out the procedure the following morning. They offered us lots of advice about his aftercare. We could not have received better service or care. Thank you.
Excellent service as always.  Warm, friendly and efficient.

After a terrible experience with another vet, Wimbledon Veterinary Surgery have naturally given us what we needed. Friendliness, patience, professionalism, trustworthy knowledge and clear communication. We now have more confidence with our new pups. A big thank you to the much valued receptionists and the incredibly supportive vets who have helped us.

Phone calls answered quickly, easy to get an appointment, lovely receptionists team and lovely vets. Had our fair share of terrible vet practices in the past with our late cat, very happy to have found a practice that genuinely cares about the animals.
Really friendly reception staff and vets, knowledgeable and helpful

Brought my very anxious cat in today and she had such great care from all of the team. Viraf was very knowledgeable and reassuring and clearly cared a lot about his patients and Alison at the desk was really kind and generous looking after her too - I came away knowing she was well looked after and in good hands, and the team went out of their way to make the experience better for her 🩷

Friendly and helpful staff. Totally professional vets who have never pushed for blood tests or scans in the first instance, which is so refreshing and honest of them. Obviously, if I took my dogs and they desperately needed these procedures, they would happen. But I just like the way they work.

We have visited the Wimbledon Veterinary Surgery twice now with our pup, they suggested a visit for a weigh in before the next visit for vaccines which really helped. We were lucky enough to see Adam for both visits and our puppy absolutely loves him, even wagged his tail seconds after the vaccine. Adam has been so reassuring and helpful, and the reception team have been lovely and welcoming both times!

Niamh is amazing.
Performed a heart scan and CT scan and was amazing with my fur baby.
Caring staff. Fab service. Thank you.
Wimbledon Veterinary Surgery are friendly and offer sensible advice. I'm very pleased with the service.

Wimbledon Vets isn't our cat's usual surgery. We go there because they are more flexible about administering the ultrasound scans he needs. They have always been very accomodating, looked after hime really well and have explained to us what's going on very clearly. They also think our cat is very handsome, so we're biased!

In fact, we were very happy until our last two experiences. However, we went there 3 months ago because of an eczema problem and our cat did not respond to the treatment. We didn't care much. However, on our last visit, they needed to have blood taken from our cat, but the vet said that he could not take the blood because our cat was very active. He gave us a urine test kit and sent us home. Since we had this procedure done twice before in different countries, it seemed very strange to me that the doctor could not do this procedure. I was very upset that we had stressed the cat for no reason and that two parts of her neck were shaved for no reason. While all this was happening, I didn't think it was right that we were charged full price. Finally, I am a little disappointed because questions like "Can they open an intravenous line?" come to mind in an emergency situation.

appointments on the day are usually easy enough to get, and we’re happy with the attention and care shown by the vets.
